name: big_beat
what: Big beat moves: the bass ducked lightly and the music bus a little, a low-pass opening on the music bus over each build with an 8-bar noise riser, a one-beat gap and an impact into each drop, a reverse fill on the chops coming out of a drop, and a tape stop on the music bus into the break and into the outro (the record that never sleeps finally winds down).
section_gains_how: Not applied blind: after the first render read measure_section_levels' contrast and run apply_section_gains with by_role {'scale': x} (tools/remix_song.py does this).
